title: Factors affecting the topological Hall effect in strongly correlated layered magnets: spin of the magnetic atoms, polar and azimuthal angle subtended by the spin texture
verdict: REPLICATED (topology/sign structure, 4/4 qualitative claims): reproduced Eq.(5) c1=sgn[sin(q2x)] for S=1 (sign agreement 1.00), the topological-Hall sign flip with modulation vector (1 flip), the azimuthal (q2x) dominance / subdominant polar factor of Eq.(7) (max|S g2/2|=0.689<1 in the well-defined lobe, numeric Chern q1x-independent), and the Haldane-analogue M-driven topological->trivial transition of Eq.(11). Independent honeycomb Bloch H(k) + Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki Chern number, CPU-only, ~30s. PARTIAL on exact phase-boundary values (Eq.10) because OCR-fragmented weights (Eq.2) were reconstructed and the p(k')/eps Fourier corrections were set to zero per the paper's own approximation.
